study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective multicenter trial
exposure: Mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal delivery vs. operative vaginal delivery)
cohort: 2,336 nulliparous women with a vertex presentation between 39 + 0 and 40 + 6 weeks' gestation
finding: Among nulliparous women who achieved a vaginal birth, higher Genesis nomogram-determined risk scores for intrapartum cesarean delivery were associated with more maternal and neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: Women with a higher Genesis risk score had an increased risk of operative vaginal delivery compared to spontaneous vaginal delivery, and operative vaginal delivery was associated with significantly higher morbidity than spontaneous vaginal delivery.
